title: WritersProof Process Proof Assertion
description: C2PA custom assertion containing the authorship verdict and composite forensic signal scores. Label: com.writerslogic.process-proof

evidenceHash.description: SHA-256 hex digest of the original evidence packet bytes

assessmentScore.description: Composite human-likeness score where 1.0 = strongly cognitive

riskLevel.description: Risk classification derived from assessment score thresholds

writingMode.description: Dominant writing mode classification from cadence analysis

compositionMode.description: Whether AI tools were involved in composition

signalScores.description: Per-dimension composite scores from the 5 forensic analysis families

cognitiveLoad.description: IKI-surprisal entanglement (Spearman rho between keystroke timing and word surprisal)

revisionTopology.description: DAG non-linearity of edit positions (branching, revisit depth, frontier distance)

errorEcology.description: Motor vs. visual error distribution (Jensen-Shannon divergence from cognitive reference)

likelihoodModel.description: Bayesian P(cognitive) from per-window log-likelihood ratio model

compositionMode.description: Pure composition vs. AI-mediated authoring score

forgeryDifficulty.description: Estimated adversary effort required to forge this evidence profile

transcriptionSuspicious.description: True when unexplained correction ratio exceeds 15% or error ecology score below 0.3

aiFluencyFlag.description: True when word-trigram perplexity falls below the AI-generated text threshold

analysisCompleteness.description: Count of successfully completed analysis modules (out of 18 total)

processStart.description: RFC 3339 timestamp of the first checkpoint in the evidence chain

processEnd.description: RFC 3339 timestamp of the last checkpoint in the evidence chain
